notes: Company background: small YC‑adjacent developer tools startup building an IDE-integrated PR reviewer (VSCode + JetBrains). Focused on accelerating code reviews for mid-size engineering teams.

Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions inside editor for inline suggestions and multi-file diff summarization. Plugin expects token streaming for comment generation with <150ms avg per-chunk latency.

Model preferences: prefer model pinning + explicit versioning. Likes CodeLlama/StarCoder family, but open to Redwood-curated model that passes security and quality evals. Wants automatic fallback to quantized 7B variants when cost spike/throughput constraint.

Scale & perf targets: 200 concurrent active reviewers across org (~150k tokens/day). Tail latency constraints: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 500ms for single-token streaming. Batch-friendly for background reranking jobs (nightly CI runs).

Security/compliance: SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs for review actions, 30-day retention configurable, data residency EU for some customers. KMS integration required for private keys in dedicated offering.
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for predictable latency (dedicated) but wants Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend on routine suggestions.
Quote from CTO (Alex Mercer): 'We need smart fallbacks that don't produce noisy comments — reranker is mission critical.'
Evaluation plan: 2-week dedicated POC (staging VPC) -> run on 4 internal repos with synthetic load; measure latency, hallucination rate on suggested comments, and cost per review metrics.

Notes from 2026-02-11 demo: SE walkthrough positive. Jordan ran live plugin demo with 1k-line PR; initial summaries concise but some verbosity on suggestions — request better temperature controls and structure templates.
Security touches: want SOC2 + additional questionnaire items answered. Provided security deck (drive link). Legal asked about data deletion flow and audit log retention.
Integration notes: will need a lightweight webhook for comment posting + duty-of-care flagging for CI; wants SDK patch that supports streaming + reconnection for flaky networks.
Potential upsell: Dedicated reserved pool after POC for predictable throughput; Optimize for batching/caching tips to reduce per‑review cost.
